title: Cryogenic Moment Series
description: Four reference-linked high-speed cryogenic captures preserving one dark-stage camera and lighting system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the black-stage setup, flash timing feel, and gravity-aware vapor. Images 02-04 preserve that exact capture logic while rotating the subject from pour to shatter, split, and crystallization.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-frozen-pour-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
